shortBio.en: AC/DC drummer on classic pocket takes; multiple exits and returns.
shortBio.zh: 经典口袋拍录音上的 AC/DC 鼓手；多次离开与回归。

body.en: Straight time, few fills—the anti-virtuoso drum chair that makes the riffs feel heavier. On and off the stool across decades.
body.zh: 直拍、少加花——反炫技鼓位，反而让 riff 更重。数十年来上上下下。
